Defect Summary: Email to End user doesn't contain any information about password and policies to change the password after first time login
Developer Comment: Fixed. The registration e-mail to the new user now follows the application team's format in Japanese and English. It gives the user ID, the initial password rule, the instruction to change the password at the first logon, and the password policy (length, characters, history, validity and lock-out).

Defect Summary: In the requests section,it shows registration email sent and password email is not sent . According to requirements,there should be only one email triggered that contains registration and password details both
Developer Comment: Fixed. For Fujitsu RACF only one e-mail is sent, holding both the registration and the initial password rule. The request details now show it as one line: "Registration e-mail (with the initial password rule)", with no separate password e-mail.

Defect Summary: Bot is creating SCTASK instead of REQ post provisioning
Developer Comment: Expected for now. The completion ticket is created in the table set under Settings (for example sc_task or incident). A REQ can only be created through a Service Catalog order. To add this we need from the ServiceNow team the catalog item, its variable names, the permission to order on behalf of the user, the assignment group and the wording for removals. The change will be made once these are received.

Defect Summary: Bot is not capturing screen of LOGON to "enviroment name" and LOGOFF screen
Developer Comment: Fixed. A screenshot is now taken with the LOGON command typed (before it is sent) and of the LOGOFF screen, each with its screen text in the evidence.

Defect Summary: The information displayed when test sign-in and terminal launch is done,doesn't seem to be accurate
Developer Comment: Fixed. The test results now read in plain words: what was tested, whether it passed, the step that failed and the answer shown by the host, with warnings about sign-off or a window left open. Technical detail is under "Show details", and the screenshots of the test are listed.

Defect Summary: When ticket is marked as closed incomplete,the 'assigned to' section is left blank in the servicenow ticket for a duplicate ticket case,not read ticket case
Developer Comment: Fixed. When the bot closes a refused ticket (duplicate or not read) as Closed Incomplete, Assigned to is kept as the bot account.

Defect Summary: The servicenow ticket is not getting generated by bot post deprovisioning (cert) operation
Developer Comment: Fixed. A completion ticket is now created after a certification removal as well as after provisioning and deprovisioning. Certification is part of the default outcomes for the completion ticket.

Defect Summary: Provisioning/Deprovisioning completed/failure,application down email are also being sent to both support team and racf admin
Developer Comment: Fixed. A new setting "Fujitsu RACF team: support reports only", on by default, limits the RACF team to the support report. Completion, failure and availability e-mails go to the support (default) recipients only. Switch it off to send those e-mails to the RACF team again.

Defect Summary: For a duplicate ticket,the email triggered contains field names as ffmid ,affiliation code
Developer Comment: Fixed. The "Matching fields" line of the duplicate e-mail now shows readable labels in Japanese and English (for Fujitsu RACF: Operation and RACF ID). The ServiceNow field names are kept only in the audit trail.

Defect Summary: Full name detail is missing from sctask being created post prov/deprov by bot
Developer Comment: Fixed. The completion ticket description now includes the user's full name and the source ServiceNow ticket (SailPoint request).

Defect Summary: On the bot ui,the fileds such as affiliation and emp code are present,It needs to be made generic
Developer Comment: Fixed. The console column names now follow the application: Fujitsu RACF requests show RACF ID and group, and lists that mix both applications show "Group / affiliation" and "User ID".

Defect Summary: Encountering driver error due to which all request are failing in BOT
Developer Comment: Fixed. The cause was that the bot's Windows session was locked, disconnected or minimized, so Windows refused the keystrokes. The bot now checks the session before starting work. While it is not available, requests wait in the queue, the System page shows the reason, an outage e-mail is sent, and processing resumes by itself when the session is back. Keep the bot's session signed in and unlocked.

Defect Summary: A plain text email is getting trigered post driver error
Developer Comment: Fixed. The error e-mail after a refused keystroke now explains the cause and what to do in plain words, in the standard e-mail layout. If an e-mail still arrives as plain text, please share the original e-mail file (.eml) so we can check how it was delivered.

Defect Summary: For 'needs verification' request status,the email triggered does not contain proper content
Developer Comment: Fixed. The "Please verify" e-mail for Fujitsu RACF now gives the reason the result could not be confirmed, the employee ID, the job number and where to find the evidence, with clear steps for the check.

Defect Summary: The 'needs verification' request ,is left in work in progress state on servicenow.It is mentioned for human review
Developer Comment: Fixed. With "close the ticket when a request fails" on (the default), a request that needs verification now closes its ticket as Closed Incomplete with a note asking for a manual check. No completion ticket is created for it. With the setting off, the ticket keeps the review note as before.

Defect Summary: No emails are triggered when rds password rotation is done
Developer Comment: Fixed. A "database password changed" e-mail is now sent when the bot takes a new database password from CyberArk. It is on by default and goes to the default recipients and the database team when set. It can be previewed on the E-mail samples page.

Defect Summary: audit trail for success database updation was shown one time but not other time
Developer Comment: Fixed. A database password change is now recorded in the audit trail on every path: the scheduled check, a refused sign-in, the Validate database password button, service start and console restart. Every click of the Validate button is also recorded.

Defect Summary: in transcation history the ticket status is showing work in progress.The final ticket status is not updated
Developer Comment: Fixed. Transaction history now shows the current ServiceNow state of the ticket, both in the list and in the details, after the bot has closed or updated it.
